Hormuz LNG traffic hits highest in October since Iran war began

马士基巨轮盐田港撞倒岸桥

Maersk boxship knocks down crane at Yantian

The 15,516 teu, 366-metre Maersk Cincinnati struck a ship-to-shore crane while berthing at Yantian International Container Terminal in Shenzhen around noon on November 9, bringing the crane down toward the container yard. The Singapore-flagged, 2024-built vessel was on voyage 645W of the Gemini Cooperation's Asia–North Europe NE3 service; a strong monsoon warning had been issued that morning, but the cause is unconfirmed, with no confirmed reports of injuries or damage, and the incident is under investigation.

马士基运营的15,516 TEU集装箱船Maersk Cincinnati（366米，新加坡旗，2024年建）于11月9日中午在深圳盐田国际集装箱码头靠泊时撞上12号泊位岸桥，致岸桥向堆场方向倒塌。该船执行双子座亚欧NE3航线645W航次；深圳气象部门当日早间曾发布强季风警告，但事故原因尚未确定，伤亡与损失情况未确认，事件正在调查中。

The United States and China have extended their mutual suspension of port fees for another two months, pushing the maritime trade dispute into January 2027. 中国10月原油进口41.94百万吨，约988万桶/日，为3月以来最高，环比增长9.4%；此前数月中国主要动用约13亿桶的原油储备。Kpler数据显示中国海运原油到港量环比增长12%至约920万桶/日；不过10月进口量仍同比下降13.3%，前十个月累计同比下降15.1%。

55干散货与能源 · 2026年11月10日

中国煤炭买家抵制印尼新合同中的豁免条款

China's coal buyers resist waiver demands in new Indonesian deals

China's coal importers are resisting attempts by Indonesian exporters to include waiver clauses in new supply contracts that would free them from strict delivery volumes if Jakarta restricts export or output quotas again. Indonesia, the world's biggest thermal coal exporter, has changed production and export policies several times this year; China's coal imports fell 6% year on year in September, and buyers are reluctant to restock aggressively at elevated prices.

中国煤炭进口商正抵制印尼出口商试图在新供应合同中加入豁免条款的要求，该条款可在印尼政府再次限制出口或产量配额时免除供货责任。印尼作为全球最大动力煤出口国，今年已多次调整生产与出口政策；中国9月煤炭进口同比下降6%，买家在高价位下不愿积极补库。

56贸易 · 2026年11月10日

中国前十个月贸易顺差达1.04万亿美元

China's trade surplus tops $1 trillion in first ten months

China's exports jumped 35.2% year on year to $412.3bn in October while imports expanded 41.6% to $307.1bn, customs data showed, bringing the trade surplus for the first ten months to $1.04 trillion — topping $1 trillion for a second consecutive year, a month earlier than in 2025. The global race to build AI infrastructure buoyed high-tech sales; the October surplus alone was $105.3bn.

中国海关总署数据显示，10月出口同比增长35.2%至4,123亿美元，进口增长41.6%至3,071亿美元，前十个月贸易顺差达1.04万亿美元，连续第二年突破万亿美元，比去年提前一个月。全球建设人工智能基础设施的热潮提振了高科技产品销售，10月单月顺差1,053亿美元。
